protocol.scope: retrospective fixed-site diagnostic; no geographic search or cross-site sharing
protocol.identity_selection: independent full-catalogue zero-timing training-only RMS at each fixed site; frozen before timing arms
protocol.sites: published Sacramento/Reno winners are evaluation-selected; reference is diagnostic only
protocol.split: reused existing masks; not a new randomized holdout; overlapping-track independence not guaranteed
protocol.residual: normalized Student-t(4); per-track CFO profiled on training only; no RMS cap or drift
